content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stock photos

Conventional platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle rent you access to their infrastructure. You pay monthly fees, accept their payment processors, and operate under their terms. Sovereign commerce stacks, in contrast, deploy infrastructure you own. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront, Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores orders, and NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. No platform lock-in. No subscriptions. Full data ownership. The tradeoff is clear: rented convenience versus owned permanence.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries—23% of the world. PayPal suspends accounts in high-risk regions, freezing funds for months. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle depend on these processors, inheriting their restrictions. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC, no buyer accounts, and a flat 0.5% fee. Transactions confirm on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10. The architecture is borderless by design.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal holds funds for days; Stripe takes 2-7 business days. Both charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Crypto payments via NOWPayments settle the moment the blockchain confirms—typically under 10 minutes. The 0.5% fee is the only cost. No monthly platform fees. No hidden charges. The real cost difference is in ownership: conventional platforms extract recurring fees; sovereign stacks are a one-time deployment. The infrastructure is yours after handoff.
Stripe operates in 46 countries. Sovereign stacks operate in 195.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With rented platforms, your store, data, and payment flow are hosted on someone else’s infrastructure. Account suspension means total shutdown. Sovereign stacks deploy on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Every component is open, auditable, and under your control. Delivery is instant, automatic, and verifiable.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you operate in a Stripe-excluded country or face PayPal restrictions, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural solution. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer architecture designed for permanence. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments in 48 hours. Five products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested. If you’re building for the long term, choose ownership over rent. Choose infrastructure over platforms.
